definitions.units: Raw SSI is a sum of fractional monthly growth rates. No division by three, extra leverage multiplier or percentage-point conversion.
definitions.monthlySelection: Last actual dated record within each calendar month for each fund, compared with the immediately preceding calendar month. No forward fill; source and author dates are retained and joined on YYYY-MM.
definitions.monthlyDefinitionEvidence: The published Eq1 defines monthly SO but does not state a precise within-month observation rule there. Last actual month record is the explicit replication convention, consistent with nearly all legacy workbook dates. Its exceptions are reported, not silently shifted.
definitions.displayed_so: Shares Outstanding (000) as printed in the current official CSV. The common thousands unit cancels in ratios.
definitions.implicit_so_precision_sensitivity: Assets Under Management / NAV / 1000. Only a precision/accounting sensitivity, not adopted as a verified substitute SO field.
definitions.splitTreatment: Use the saved histories as printed, with no additional split factors. A constant retrospective unit multiplier cancels from within-series growth; printed rounding need not cancel. Event-by-event split validation is a separate audit. No claim of a complete historical vintage is made.
definitions.normalization: Fit only descriptive affine author = a+b*raw on each sheet coverage. Also report direct population/sample standardization on that identical coverage. These are ex-post definition comparisons and cannot be inputs available at the historical decision time.
definitions.anomalies: Report the ten largest absolute affine residual months in each fixed comparison; retain every month and make no exclusion or alternate definition selection.

monthEndCalendarCheck.definition: Compare each per-fund last actual month record to the last date present for all six funds in that month; check the previous-month baseline too.
monthEndCalendarCheck.primaryDefinitionUnchanged: All SSI calculations remain per-fund last actual record. Differences, if any, are reported rather than silently substituted.

authorOverlap.interpretation: Near-exact affine overlap is compatible with changed centering/scaling. It is not evidence identifying or ruling out revisions to the underlying share data.

coverage: last actual monthly record and thousands units

limitations: The published paper primarily uses Bloomberg SO; ProShares is a crosscheck and daily-test source. Current official CSVs are not the original Bloomberg inputs or the original historical vintage.
The author workbook supplies standardized legacy outputs, not raw six-fund inputs or its exact centering/scaling parameters. The two sheets do not cover the complete final published sample.
No source-return association, portfolio payoff or predictive test enters this reconciliation. Matching data definitions alone would not validate an investment signal.

Observation dates, HTTP retrieval/Last-Modified and retrospective affine normalization do not establish when a historical observation was first publicly available. Split, precision, revision and timing questions remain distinct.
